title.note: Game title, glossary keep; the guide keeps game titles in English.

hud.reel.note: "spole ind" = wind the line in on the reel, the Danish angling verb; same verb as the pass Autospoling. 8/8.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form so 0, 1 and 12 all read right; "madding" is the everyday Danish word for fishing bait.

catch.success.note: Restructured per the guide: colon and parentheses keep the inserted tier and fish name out of en/et and adjective agreement. Reads "Du fangede: Guldkarpe (Sjælden)!".

catch.escaped.note: "It" made explicit as the generic "fisken"; "slap væk" is the natural phrase for a fish getting away.

catch.new_record.note: For the developer: {weight} arrives as "12.4"; Danish writes "12,4". Format it by LocaleId.

fish.lantern_eel.note: lanterne (lantern) + ål (eel): keeps the glowing-lantern idea and echoes the title Lantern Lake, on the pattern of the real Danish "lanternefisk". "Lygteål" is a shorter alternative.

rarity.mythic.note: Tier above "Legendarisk"; base form, the usual shape of Danish rarity tags.

shop.rods.note: The full word "Fiskestænger" is 12, over the estimated 10; in a fishing shop "stænger" reads as fishing rods, as Danish anglers say "stang og hjul". Use "Fiskestænger" if the tab fits 12.

shop.equip.note: "Use" as the button, paired with the state label "I brug"; "Udstyr" would also read as the noun "equipment".

shop.equipped.note: "In use" state label, as the context allows; needs no agreement with the rod.

pass.auto_reel.note: auto + spoling (the noun of "spole", as in "indspoling"), so it shares the verb of hud.reel "Spol ind". Written as one word like Microsoft's Danish "Autofyld". The Creator Hub pass name should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Lykkemadding fordobler din chance for sjældne fisk!
pass.lucky_bait.note: "lykke-" is how Danish builds "lucky" compounds (lykkemønt, lykkekløver; the guide's Lykkeeliksir); the luck stat itself is "held" in friends.boost, as in Minecraft's Danish Luck effect. Same concept, natural form for each slot.

sell.done.note: "fisk" is the same in singular and plural, so {count} = 1 is fine; coins moved to a label ("Mønter: +340") because "1 mønter" would be wrong. The "+" marks earned coins, not the balance.

sell.prompt.note: 19/21. The guide's fuller "Tryk på E for at sælge" is 22, one over the estimate; "Tryk E" is common in Danish game prompts. Source-side: phone and console players have no E key; ActionText "Sælg" would serve everyone.

ascend.button.note: "avancere" = move up a level, as in sports ("avancere til kvartfinalen"); neither religious nor climbing. "Stig op" was rejected: it reads as climbing up or ascending to heaven. Accent per the Microsoft -er imperative rule. Fallback if a native reviewer prefers: keep "Ascend", as the guide keeps "Rebirth".

ascend.confirm.text: Vil du avancere nu? Du starter forfra, men fanger sjældne fisk {bonus} % oftere.
ascend.confirm.note: "Vil du ...?" per the guide; same verb as ascend.button. "starter forfra" = start over. Space before % per Danish style ("25 %").

weather.storm.text: En storm er på vej! Sjældne fisk bider på.
weather.storm.note: "bider på" = take the bait, the fishing sense.

quest.title.note: Guide: "mission" is natural in games; "Opgaver" sounds like homework.

quest.catch_n.note: "fisk" is the same in singular and plural, so n = 1 reads right. Moonlit Bay -> "Måneskinsbugten" (moonlight bay), a definite place name like Danish bay names; "i" because the fish are in the bay. If in-world signs stay English, that name will not match.

quest.claim.note: Guide: "Hent" for Claim, not the legal "Gør krav på".

friends.boost.text: Når du fisker med venner, får du +{percent} % held
friends.boost.note: Kept a statement: "When you fish with friends, you get +N % luck". "held" is the luck stat. Space before % per Danish style. 41/57.

trade.accept.text: {player} har sagt ja til at bytte
trade.accept.note: "has said yes to trading": gender-free and 25/33. "har accepteret din bytteanmodning" is 34, over budget; the noun "byttet" is avoided because it also means "the prey" in a fishing game.

codes.redeemed.text: Koden er indløst! Nyd din belønning.
codes.redeemed.note: "indløse" = redeem, per the guide. "Nyd din belønning" is everyday Danish; "God fornøjelse med belønningen" would make it 49/45.

afk.kicked.text: Du har været inaktiv for længe og er stoppet med at fiske.
afk.kicked.note: Perfect tense for a message read after the fact; no mention of leaving the server, as in the source.

event.ends.note: For the developer: {time} arrives as "2d 4h"; Danish is "2 d 4 t" (t = timer, never h). Format it by LocaleId.

daily.streak.text: {day}. dag i træk! Kom igen i morgen for at få flere belønninger.
daily.streak.note: Danish says "3. dag i træk" (third day in a row) for a streak; the ordinal needs no plural, so day = 1 reads "1. dag i træk". "for more" made explicit as more rewards, per context. 60/62.

tip.night.text: Tip: Nogle fisk bider kun om natten.

group.join.text: Meld dig ind i gruppen, og få 50 gratis madding!
group.join.note: Guide: "gruppe", and the comma before "og" joining two imperative main clauses is required. "50 gratis madding" uses the mass noun with a number, as English does with bait; a native check is welcome. 48/60.

leaderboard.biggest.note: "Tungeste" = heaviest, per context (weight, not length). "Største fangst" is the more idiomatic alternative if size reads fine to the developer.
